Summer round-robin that books the Tokyo Dome main event.

How G1 Climax connects

  • Topic: NJPW — The G1 Climax is New Japan's summer round-robin tournament.
  • Event: Wrestle Kingdom — Winning the G1 Climax books the Wrestle Kingdom main event.

What is G1 Climax?

The G1 Climax is New Japan's summer round-robin tournament. Winning it historically earned a Wrestle Kingdom shot at the IWGP prize.
